text:
sam: Heads-up 1: Arcadia Financial wants a 72h POC to validate switching from AltAPI. Key asks: function/tool-call parity, sample-set diff, short reserved vs hosted cost, and their security questionnaire answers (SAML, BYO KMS, peering). Kickoff 2pm today. cc @rita @yusuf
rita: I'll build a lightweight adapter. AltAPI uses inline markers like <ACTION name=charge id=42/>. Plan: regex extract -> structured tool call. Prototype tonight.
yusuf: I'll run a 250-prompt diff (mix: short chat, long instructions, multi-tool). Two modes: our default and temp=0.0 + strict stops. ETA ~5h for first CSV.
dev-bot: Security questionnaire created: https://redwood.example.com/secforms/arcadia-2026. Checklist: SOC2, SAML/SCIM, VPC peering, BYO KMS, audit logs >=120d.
sam: Pricing note for presales slide: need hosted vs 2-week dedicated trial numbers to show unit economics.
carmen: Quick figures for slides: hosted gen $0.016/1k tokens, embeddings $0.0038/1k. Two-week dedicated trial (pro-rated) estimate ~$7.5k (2-node reserve). I'll confirm with finance and post a formal PO number.
yusuf: Early diff stats (first 60 prompts): ~11% token-level divergence default. Forcing temp=0.0 and canonical stop tokens drops to ~3.1%. Biggest diffs: trailing punctuation, conversation framing, and AltAPI's truncated streaming chunks.
rita: Adapter snippet (prototype): ```json
{
  "pattern": "<ACTION (.*?)\/>",
  "extract": "name=($NAME) id=($ID)",
  "map": "{\"tool\": $NAME, \"args\": {\"id\": $ID}}"
}
``` We'll also strip AltAPI post-processing tokens before diff.
legal-liaison: Contract asks flagged: data residency, right-to-audit, KMS language for BYO keys, and indemnity limits. Need legal review; expect 48-96h.
netops: We can provision VPC peering. Need CIDR, contact, and billing code. Typical turnaround 24h once provided.
sam: Owners: adapter=rita, diff+reports=yusuf, pricing=carmen, legal=legal-liaison, peering=netops. I'll assemble the POC checklist and share the doc after kickoff.
yusuf: I'll include 30 multi-tool prompts and 20 streaming-edge cases to catch AltAPI chunking differences. Output CSV + sample pairs uploaded to POC folder.
carmen: Also confirm billing granularity: Arcadia asked per-token vs per-request and minimum commit thresholds. I'll include both options in the quote.
rita: For the POC deck please include a before/after sample showing AltAPI inline action -> normalized tool call and the token delta.
dev-bot: Uploaded initial harness run logs: https://redwood.example.com/pocs/arcadia-1793/logs
sam: Thanks team. We'll sync after Yusuf posts full diff. Quick note: keep the adapter as a toggle so production doesn't change existing customers. :thumbsup:
